name: Java SDK Manager (SDKMAN)
description: Installs SDKMAN so SDK-managed Java tools (maven, gradle, jdks) can be provisioned.

postInstallCheck.command: test -s /home/jovyan/.sdkman/bin/sdkman-init.sh && test -s /home/jovyan/.sdkman/var/platform && test -s /home/jovyan/.sdkman/var/candidates && test -s /home/jovyan/.sdkman/etc/config && test -s /home/jovyan/.sdkman/var/version && test -s /home/jovyan/.sdkman/var/version_native && test -d /home/jovyan/.sdkman/candidates && command -v sdk >/dev/null && echo "java-sdkman: check OK (init artefact present, synthesised state present, sdk resolvable)"
postInstallCheck.description: Verify the SDKMAN transport for jovyan: init artefact present, the synthesised state the mirrored release archive does NOT ship (var/platform, var/candidates, etc/config, var/version, var/version_native) present and non-empty, candidates/ present, and sdk resolvable in the check shell (run-check-env.sh sources sdkman-init.sh before eval). No child shell: sdk is an unexported function; no || fallback: absence must exit non-zero.
